description: Veloren is an open-world voxel action RPG; this image runs a dedicated multiplayer server. Players connect with the Veloren client on port 14004.

tips.before_install: This is a game server with no web UI. The first start generates a world and can take several minutes. Connect using the Veloren client to port `14004`. Server commands are available from the CasaOS terminal.
